name: gitlab-review
description: GitLab merge-request discussions get race-safe fixes with complete discussion inventory, source-project-bound exact-SHA pushes, reviewer-owned resolution, idempotent replies, and exact-head CI handoff proof.

interface.shortDescription: GitLab MR feedback fixed on exact head.
interface.longDescription: GitLab merge-request discussions receive a race-safe response against a frozen review epoch and exact source head. The plugin classifies current feedback, binds authorized exact-SHA publication to authenticated source Project, Merge Request, and Branch evidence, guards concurrent pushes and reviewer edits, keeps resolution reviewer-owned, deduplicates replies, and binds CI and handoff proof to the pushed head.
capabilities: Complete paginated GitLab merge request discussion inventory
Immutable head, diff-version, note, and resolution race guards
Source-project-bound exact-SHA push preparation and drift verification
Idempotent same-thread evidence replies with ambiguous-write readback
Human reviewer-owned resolution with explicit authorization gates
Exact local, remote, merge-request, pipeline, and final-discussion handoff proof
interface.defaultPrompt: Address the unresolved feedback on this GitLab merge request and prove the result against the exact current head.
